# Default Workspace Rules

- When the user writes in English, gently correct grammar, vocabulary, or phrasing errors. Be concise: give a one-line fix and a one-line explanation of why it is better.
- Announce "Using <skill-name>" in chat when you start a skill.
- Use `./tmp` for all temporary or intermediate files. Never use the system `/tmp` directory.
